three_key_limitations.title: Execution evidence is incomplete
three_key_limitations.detail: Acceptance, comments and broad success reports do not jointly identify the exact executed version, complete original input and required output. The correct pooled result is 0/8 confirmed, not 0/8 actual successes. J3 and P3 explicitly contain positive self-reports.

three_key_limitations.title: Public snapshot and denominator limits
three_key_limitations.detail: The API records currently visible posts and comments, not deleted/private histories or past comment edits. Current acceptance has no event timestamp. Eight recruited question cases are a descriptive pool; P3 stays in this pool even though it is excluded from strict packet-policy comparisons. No population success rate or causal effect follows.

three_key_limitations.title: Construct, version and phase boundaries
three_key_limitations.detail: Documentary availability under a helper-allowed interpretation does not establish a novel/easier solution for P1. J2 and J3 later use different input/procedure details; P3 lacks the promised Dockerfile and a resolved latest-stable source. Post-outcome evidence cannot repair frozen packets. This is machine review with prior context, not blinded human testing.
